text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ten prominent British companies plan to invest millions of dollars in Zimbabwe next year and more investment should be expected in the field of joint ventures, the visiting Lord Mayor of London, Sir John Chalstrey said.

- The European Union may provide the Zimbabwean government with Z$40 million to boost its free crop pack programme this year, the head of the European Commission in Zimbabwe, Michael Laidler said on Tuesday.
- Yugoslav President Zoran Lilic arrives in Zimbabwe this morning for a four-day state visit aimed at promoting relations.
